fusions.name: Dull Incantation
fusions.desc: Flicks a rune-cut chip that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance of [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Word
fusions.desc: A closing word that deals 22 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Carved Glyph
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You have 8% earth resistance.
